what: Three release dry runs were green although the update path was broken: the dry runs ran against an unchanged upstream manifest, so no run ever tested a tree whose vendored ocx pin had moved. 20 unit tests used the vendored src/ocx/dist.json as their fixture and hard-coded its version, and would have failed the release matrix on the next ocx release.
tell: With the vendored manifest moved to another ocx version, task test:unit reports 20 failures in update-dist.bats and release-assets.bats (assert_output 'updated 0.6.8 -> 0.6.8').
proposed_change: A rehearsal of an unattended release must start from a vendored state that differs from upstream (one release behind). Tests use a frozen fixture manifest, never the live vendored file; test/unit/pin-independence.bats now guards this.
